family.description: Clusters of short DNA repeats with non-homologous spacers, which are found at regular intervals in the genomes of phylogenetically distinct prokaryotic species, comprise a family with recognisable features. This family is known as CRISPR (short for Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats). A number of protein families appear only in association with these repeats and are designated Cas (CRISPR-associated) proteins [[cite:PUB00043286]]. This entry represents Csm2 Type III-A, a family of Cas proteins also known as TM1810/Csm2 [[cite:PUB00078085]].
family.name: Csm2 Type III-A
